name: --ds-border-width-thin
comment: Strokes are the one exception to the 4px grid: a 4px hairline would be too heavy.

name: --ds-easing-out
comment: Fast start, gentle stop: for elements responding to the user.

name: --ds-easing-out-emphasized
comment: Arrives quickly, then glides into place: for elements entering the screen.

name: --ds-easing-in
comment: Slow start, fast finish: for elements leaving the screen.

name: --ds-easing-in-out
comment: Symmetric: for elements that move or resize while staying on screen.

name: --ds-shadow-xs
comment: charcoal.900 at 8% opacity.

name: --ds-shadow-sm
comment: Two layers of charcoal.900: a tight contact shadow and a soft ambient one.

name: --ds-shadow-md
comment: Two layers of charcoal.900: a tight contact shadow and a soft ambient one.

name: --ds-shadow-lg
comment: Two layers of charcoal.900: a tight contact shadow and a soft ambient one.

name: --ds-shadow-ambient-md
comment: A contact shadow plus an ambient one with no negative spread, so it outlines every edge.

name: --ds-shadow-ambient-lg
comment: A contact shadow plus a wider ambient one with no negative spread, so it outlines every edge.

name: --ds-shadow-inset
comment: charcoal.900 at 8% opacity, cast inwards from the top edge.

name: --ds-semantic-border-width-default
comment: Quiet outlines and dividers: an input's edge, a card, a separator.

name: --ds-semantic-border-width-interactive
comment: The stronger outline of buttons and other controls you press.

name: --ds-semantic-border-width-selected
comment: The outline of a selected card or option. Pair it with a colour change, never colour alone.

name: --ds-semantic-border-width-indicator
comment: Bars that mark the current item, such as an active tab or navigation link.

name: --ds-semantic-border-width-halo
comment: The soft ring around a focused input, drawn with box-shadow.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-brand-soft
comment: Pale tint for quiet, non-interactive labels such as a soft Badge. Pair it with the matching text colour.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-subtle-base
comment: Neutral dark fill (e.g. the secondary Button), not a faint surface: "subtle" means low-chroma, not low-contrast.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-subtle-soft
comment: Pale tint for quiet, non-interactive labels such as a soft Badge. Pair it with the matching text colour.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-utility-error-soft
comment: Pale tint for quiet, non-interactive labels such as a soft Badge. Pair it with the matching text colour.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-utility-success-soft
comment: Pale tint for quiet, non-interactive labels such as a soft Badge. Pair it with the matching text colour.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-utility-warning-hover
comment: Lighter, not darker: the text is already the darkest honey (900), so darker hover/active backgrounds fail 4.5:1.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-utility-warning-active
comment: Lighter, not darker: the text is already the darkest honey (900), so darker hover/active backgrounds fail 4.5:1.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-utility-warning-soft
comment: Pale tint for quiet, non-interactive labels such as a soft Badge. Pair it with the matching text colour.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-utility-information-soft
comment: Pale tint for quiet, non-interactive labels such as a soft Badge. Pair it with the matching text colour.

name: --ds-semantic-color-text-subtle-disabled
comment: Secondary text that must stay readable on a disabled field (e.g. an Input unit).

name: --ds-semantic-color-border-subtle-base
comment: Darker than border.default on purpose: a neutral edge that pairs with background.subtle. For faint dividers use border.disabled.

name: --ds-semantic-focus-ring-color
comment: The default ring colour, the same sage as border.brand. A component whose background is too close to it defines its own focus-ring token in tier 3.

name: --ds-semantic-focus-ring-offset
comment: Stroke geometry, not layout spacing: the gap matches the ring width, so it stays off the 4px spacing scale.

name: --ds-semantic-focus-ring-offset-inset
comment: Draws the ring inside the element, for items in clipped or tightly packed containers: menu options, tabs, table cells.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-duration-instant
comment: Press feedback and small toggles, such as a checkbox tick.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-duration-fast
comment: State changes in place: hover, focus and colour changes.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-duration-moderate
comment: Small elements entering or leaving: tooltips, menus, an expanding section.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-duration-slow
comment: Large surfaces entering or leaving: dialogs, drawers, sheets.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-duration-relaxed
comment: Decorative motion that should feel calm, such as a link underline drawing in. Pair it with the move easing.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-duration-deliberate
comment: Rare, emphasised moments that the reader should notice. Use sparingly.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-easing-standard
comment: State changes in place, such as hover and pressed.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-easing-enter
comment: Elements arriving on screen: they settle softly into place.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-easing-exit
comment: Elements leaving the screen: they speed up as they go.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-easing-move
comment: Elements that move or resize while staying on screen.

name: --ds-semantic-motion-easing-linear
comment: Continuous motion with no start or end, such as a spinner or a progress bar.

name: --ds-semantic-shadow-raised-base
comment: Barely-there lift so a control, such as an input, reads as a surface.

name: --ds-semantic-shadow-raised-hover
comment: A raised surface lifting under the pointer.

name: --ds-semantic-shadow-card-base
comment: A card resting on the page: a soft shadow on every edge, so it stands out without a border.

name: --ds-semantic-shadow-card-hover
comment: A clickable card lifting under the pointer.

name: --ds-semantic-shadow-floating
comment: Menus, popovers and tooltips that float above the content.

name: --ds-semantic-shadow-overlay
comment: Dialogs, drawers and sheets that sit above everything else.

name: --ds-semantic-shadow-sunken
comment: A well pressed into the page, such as the track of a segmented control.

name: --ds-semantic-size-selection-control-sm
comment: The box of a checkbox or radio. In rem, so it grows with the label next to it.

name: --ds-semantic-size-selection-control-md
comment: The box of a checkbox or radio. In rem, so it grows with the label next to it.

name: --ds-semantic-size-selection-control-lg
comment: The box of a checkbox or radio. In rem, so it grows with the label next to it.

name: --ds-semantic-size-selection-indicator-sm
comment: The dot of a checked radio, centred in its selection-control box.

name: --ds-semantic-size-selection-indicator-md
comment: The dot of a checked radio, centred in its selection-control box.

name: --ds-semantic-size-selection-indicator-lg
comment: The dot of a checked radio, centred in its selection-control box.

name: --ds-semantic-size-switch-height-sm
comment: Switch track. Height minus thumb is 8px: 4px on each side, 2px of edge and 2px of air.

name: --ds-semantic-size-switch-height-md
comment: Switch track. Height minus thumb is 8px: 4px on each side, 2px of edge and 2px of air.

name: --ds-semantic-size-switch-height-lg
comment: Switch track. Height minus thumb is 8px: 4px on each side, 2px of edge and 2px of air.

name: --ds-semantic-size-switch-width-sm
comment: Switch track. Wide enough that the thumb sits clearly to the left or to the right.

name: --ds-semantic-size-switch-width-md
comment: Switch track. Wide enough that the thumb sits clearly to the left or to the right.

name: --ds-semantic-size-switch-width-lg
comment: Switch track. Wide enough that the thumb sits clearly to the left or to the right.

name: --ds-semantic-size-switch-thumb-sm
comment: The knob of a switch. 8px smaller than its track height, so it sits 4px inside the edge.

name: --ds-semantic-size-switch-thumb-md
comment: The knob of a switch. 8px smaller than its track height, so it sits 4px inside the edge.

name: --ds-semantic-size-switch-thumb-lg
comment: The knob of a switch. 8px smaller than its track height, so it sits 4px inside the edge.

name: --ds-semantic-size-tag-sm
comment: Height of static labels such as badges. They are not clickable, so they may sit below the 24px target size.

name: --ds-semantic-size-tag-md
comment: Height of static labels such as badges. They are not clickable, so they may sit below the 24px target size.

name: --ds-semantic-size-target-min
comment: The smallest pointer target WCAG 2.5.8 allows. Nothing clickable is smaller.

name: --ds-semantic-size-target-comfortable
comment: The target for touch-first controls and primary actions on small screens.

name: --ds-semantic-size-prose
comment: Maximum width of running text: about 70 to 80 characters of body copy per line.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-display-lg-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-display-md-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-heading-lg-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-heading-md-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-heading-sm-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-body-lg-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-body-md-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-body-sm-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-control-md-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-control-lg-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-label-lg-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-label-md-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-label-sm-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-semantic-typography-caption-md-shorthand
comment: The CSS font shorthand. It cannot carry letter spacing: set letter-spacing too.

name: --ds-component-breadcrumb-text-default
comment: Ancestor links stay quiet so the current page and page title stand out.

name: --ds-component-breadcrumb-text-current
comment: The page the user is on, paired with heavier weight.

name: --ds-component-breadcrumb-separator-color
comment: Muted stone divider that still clears 3:1 contrast against the page.

name: --ds-component-breadcrumb-shape-radii
comment: Rounds the focus ring around each breadcrumb link.

name: --ds-component-breadcrumb-min-target
comment: Keeps standalone breadcrumb links at or above the 24px target height of WCAG 2.5.8.

name: --ds-component-card-media-background
comment: Shown while the image loads or when it has transparent areas.

name: --ds-component-chip-shape-selected-edge
comment: Total edge of a selected chip. The border stays 1px and an inset shadow adds the rest, so selecting never shifts the layout.

name: --ds-component-empty-state-description-max-width
comment: Keeps the description to a comfortable line length.

name: --ds-component-link-text-standalone-default
comment: Dark at rest, like the text around it: the context says it is a link.

name: --ds-component-link-text-standalone-hover
comment: Turns to the brand colour of the underline.

name: --ds-component-link-underline-rest-width
comment: Inline links: the resting underline that tells a link apart from the text around it.

name: --ds-component-link-underline-active-width
comment: The underline of a hovered link and of the current page: it marks a selection, like an active tab.

name: --ds-component-link-shape-radii
comment: Rounds the focus ring around the link text.

name: --ds-component-pagination-text-current
comment: On the brand fill of the current page.

name: --ds-component-search-field-gap
comment: Between the label, the field row and the hint.

name: --ds-component-search-field-row-gap
comment: Between the field and the Search button.

name: --ds-component-skeleton-background-highlight
comment: The lighter step of the pulse.

name: --ds-component-skeleton-shape-circle-size
comment: The size of a circle without a width, such as a small avatar.

name: --ds-component-skeleton-motion-duration
comment: One half of the pulse; the loop runs it forth and back.

name: --ds-component-switch-track-gap
comment: Space between the track and the label, so the label can be clicked as part of the control.

name: --ds-component-switch-thumb-unchecked
comment: The knob on the unchecked track: a neutral dark on a white track, so the state never rests on the track colour alone.

name: --ds-component-switch-thumb-disabled
comment: Secondary text that stays readable on a disabled surface.

name: --ds-component-textarea-size-sm-min-height
comment: Even with rows="1", the field is as tall as the Button beside it.

name: --ds-component-textarea-size-md-min-height
comment: Even with rows="1", the field is as tall as the Button beside it.

name: --ds-component-textarea-size-lg-min-height
comment: Even with rows="1", the field is as tall as the Button beside it.
